Name: Durumi Hut - Harvest Helpers and Bucket Watering
Author: asb3967
Description:
[b]Durumi Hut 1.2.1[/b]
[b]1.2.1 interior hotfix:[/b] Added one clear floor row beneath the south furniture, removed the black lower border strip and finished the doorway flush with its frame. Furniture, rest anchors and door/warp coordinates are unchanged. Native entry, routes and walking exit were rechecked. The current thumbnail shows 1.2.1; older 1.2 gameplay images remain as version history.

A Robin-built fan creation with two upgrades, physical bucket watering, weather outfits and an enterable hut. Includes all 12 base-game languages. AI-generated code, artwork, translations and documentation are disclosed.

[b]A place to rest when it rains[/b]
Enter each hut through its door. The timber interior follows the commissioning user's supplied design: kitchen, central dining table, two sleeping places (three after expansion), hearth seating, storage and a study desk. The kitchen includes a sink; the well upgrade adds bucket-rinsing/storage details. Furniture and drying gear are decoration, not cooking or clothes-drying simulation.
On rainy mornings helpers start inside. If rain begins while working, they wear yellow raincoats and physically return through their door to rest. Indoor helpers use normal or winter clothing. Idle winter helpers also rest inside, leaving in warm clothes when real crop watering is needed and returning afterward. Rain does not enable harvesting or watering.
Indoor and outdoor helpers are the same native population. Sitting, book and mug poses show quiet rest; they are not a full NPC daily-life simulation. The interior output box is the same 36-slot harvest chest, including the harvest toggle. Leaving returns to the corresponding hut.

[b]Build and upgrade[/b]
Robin offers construction without wizard-quest, year or season unlocks; normal shop hours and construction scheduling apply.
Base: 13x13 (radius 6), 2 helpers. 20,000g + 200 stone + 9 starfruit + 100 fiber; 2 days.
Upgrade 1: 17x17 (radius 8), 3 helpers. 5,000g + 100 wood + 100 stone; 1 day.
Upgrade 2: same 17x17 and 3 helpers, plus a small well and bucket watering. 10,000g + 200 stone + 5 iron bars + 10 hardwood; 2 days.
All exterior footprints are 3x2; range includes the building. The original Junimo Hut remains available.

[b]Physical bucket watering[/b]
Helpers fill at the well, carry water to a crop and pour before its soil becomes wet. A bucket waters 8 targets before refilling. Filling, walking and pouring take time; the same maximum 3 workers also harvest. Watering works from 6am until 7pm and stops in rain.
Growing crops, trellis crops, wild seeds and outdoor garden pots are eligible. Dead crops, empty soil, already-wet soil and crops needing no water are skipped. Reachable routes are required. Native harvest restrictions still apply in rain, winter and traditional festivals; the harvest toggle is independent of watering.

[b]Install and installer notice[/b]
Requires your own Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Close the game, replace Mods/DurumiHut and launch through SMAPI. Content Patcher is not required. Existing 1.0/1.1 huts are updated in place; back up saves before updating.
This update is the standard mod ZIP with mod source and build instructions. The previous optional Windows installer is quarantined by Nexus and its executable has detections from multiple security engines. These have not been established as false positives. A replacement installer is withheld pending review; do not disable protection or bypass the quarantine. Install SMAPI from its official site. Existing standalone users may replace only DurumiHut-Standalone/Mods/DurumiHut. No proprietary game files are distributed.

[b]Languages and AI disclosure[/b]
English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Hungarian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish. Translations are AI-generated; full native-speaker proofreading is not claimed.
OpenAI Codex/GPT-6 Astra assisted code, review, translations and documentation. Built-in OpenAI image generation created and edited original artwork. AI-Generated Content and AI Media apply. Gameplay screenshots are actual captures; images labeled AI concept art are illustrations, not in-game graphics.
This is an unofficial Drami fan creation. Durumi is a user-defined 10-year-old androgynous child. Player farmers and ordinary Junimos retain their original appearances.

[b]Credits, support and removal[/b]
Stardew Valley: ConcernedApe. SMAPI: Pathoschild and contributors. Native tiles/furniture load from the installed game at runtime. The mod source is included.
Before removal: leave the hut, empty output, demolish all Durumi Huts with the mod installed, save a day, then remove the mod. Do not remove building data needed by a save.
Tested in Windows single-player, including copied 1.1 save migration. Multiplayer and other Junimo overhaul combinations remain unverified. Please keep private save/account data out of public bug reports.
